items.title: Wrought Iron Cross Scroll DXF Panel for Gates & Doors
items.description: Two mirrored scroll sections stack vertically, each built around a crossing X and a central teardrop, in the style of traditional iron gate inserts. The bold, thick strokes give it real presence on a large door or gate panel.

items.title: Diamond Cross DXF Grid for Airy Privacy Screens
items.description: Small diamonds nest inside a dense grid of overlapping X-crosses, creating an airy, evenly perforated surface. The fine repeating lattice suits privacy screens, fence infill, and gates needing good airflow with a crisp geometric look.

items.title: Free Vesica Lattice Mesh DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Screens
items.description: A dense, all-over lattice of overlapping lens shapes and small diamond accents forms a rippling, fabric-like mesh across the entire panel. With no central medallion or border, this design reads as pure repeating texture, well suited as a background or infill pattern rather than a focal artwork.
